title: Pandora stops playing EVERY time xdrip gets a sensor reading
body:
S7, android 8.0.0. xDrip version 2018.08.05 (don't ask--I have to)  If I play Pandora (using speaker on phone), the moment that my G5 sensor sends data to the phone, Pandora goes into PAUSE mode.   I also use xdrip as a follower for another person and that copy of xdrip doesn't interfer with Pandora.   the second copy is installed on the phone via App Cloner.

I turned off Notifications for xDrip.  I am not using the SPEAK readings feature at this time.  Pandora is set to not be an app that is excluded from battery optimization.

comments.body: I've been emailing Pandora support back and forth.   they haven't got a solution yet.   there is a message on Pandora's help page about it pausing and their instructions to fix it are useless (for me).

after countless emails back and forth, the word from pandora is that they are aware it's a problem and are working on it.  hopefully some of the info I sent them about my phone will help pin down the issue.
